proposals.before: Capable Officials — Da Gongding, Xiao Wen, Ma Renwang, Yelü Duo, Luwo, Yang Zunxu, and Wang Tang
proposals.after: Capable Officials — Da Gongding, Xiao Wen, Ma Renwang, Yelü Duoluwo, Yang Zunxu, and Wang Tang
proposals.reason: Chinese 耶律鐸魯斡 is one personal name; the idiomatic English incorrectly splits it into two people (Yelü Duo, Luwo).

proposals.before: Capable Officials ○ Da Gongding, Xiao Wen, Ma Renwang, Yelü Duo, Luwo, Yang Zunxu, Wang Tang
proposals.after: Capable Officials ○ Da Gongding, Xiao Wen, Ma Renwang, Yelü Duoluwo, Yang Zunxu, Wang Tang
proposals.reason: Literal English likewise splits 耶律鐸魯斡 into two names; it should remain one person.

proposals.before: He reformed the magistrates of Liang Township, reduced corvée and labor service, devoted effort to farming and sericulture, built a Confucian temple and school, and the people of his district submitted to transformation.
proposals.after: He was transferred to magistrate of Liangxiang, reduced corvée and labor service, devoted effort to farming and sericulture, built a Confucian temple and school, and the people of his district submitted to transformation.
proposals.reason: 改良鄉令 means he was reassigned as magistrate of Liangxiang, not that he reformed (plural) magistrates of a township.

decisions.reason: s0001 lists six officials ending in 耶律鐸魯斡楊遵勖王棠; 耶律鐸魯斡 is one personal name (Yelü Duoluwo), not two people. The proposed reunification matches the Chinese.
The literal line likewise splits 耶律鐸魯斡 into Yelü Duo and Luwo; one name Yelü Duoluwo is required.

decisions.after: He was reassigned as magistrate of Liangxiang, reduced corvée and labor service, devoted effort to farming and sericulture, built a Confucian temple and school, and the people of his district submitted to transformation.
decisions.reason: s0021 改良鄉令 is career transfer into the magistracy of Liangxiang (良鄉令), not reforming plural township magistrates. The proposal’s sense is right, but “transferred to magistrate” is ungrammatical; “reassigned as magistrate of Liangxiang” is the accurate wording.

claimRetractions.reason: Accepting r0001 shows “Yelü Duo” / 耶律鐸 exists only as the first half of the mistranslated split of 耶律鐸魯斡; s0001 supports no such alternate name.
Accepting r0001 shows “Luwo” / 魯斡 exists only as the second half of the mistranslated split of 耶律鐸魯斡; s0001 supports no such alternate name.
